def solve(case):
    # validate tokens
    if not isinstance(case, dict):
        raise ValueError("case must be a dict")
    tokens = case.get("tokens")
    if not isinstance(tokens, list) or not all(isinstance(t, str) for t in tokens):
        raise ValueError("tokens must be a list of strings")
    calls = case.get("calls")
    if not isinstance(calls, list):
        raise ValueError("calls must be a list")
    # validate each call
    for call in calls:
        if not isinstance(call, dict):
            raise ValueError("each call must be a dict")
        for key in ("call_id", "start", "end", "score", "replacement_tokens"):
            if key not in call:
                raise ValueError(f"call missing key {key}")
        call_id = call["call_id"]
        if not isinstance(call_id, str):
            raise ValueError("call_id must be string")
        start = call["start"]
        end = call["end"]
        score = call["score"]
        if not isinstance(start, int) or not isinstance(end, int):
            raise ValueError("start and end must be ints")
        if start < 0 or end > len(tokens) or start >= end:
            raise ValueError("invalid start/end")
        if not isinstance(score, (int, float)):
            raise ValueError("score must be numeric")
        repl = call["replacement_tokens"]
        if not isinstance(repl, list) or not all(isinstance(x, str) for x in repl):
            raise ValueError("replacement_tokens must be list of strings")
    # sort candidates
    sorted_calls = sorted(calls, key=lambda c: (-c["score"], c["start"], c["call_id"]))
    selected = []
    intervals = []  # list of (start, end)
    for call in sorted_calls:
        s, e = call["start"], call["end"]
        # check overlap with any selected interval
        overlap = False
        for (sel_s, sel_e) in intervals:
            # intervals are [start, end)
            if not (e <= sel_s or s >= sel_e):
                overlap = True
                break
        if not overlap:
            selected.append(call)
            intervals.append((s, e))
    # sort selected by start for reporting
    selected_sorted = sorted(selected, key=lambda c: (c["start"], c["call_id"]))
    selected_ids = [c["call_id"] for c in selected_sorted]
    # apply replacements from right to left
    # copy tokens list
    new_tokens = tokens[:]
    # sort selected by start descending
    for call in sorted(selected, key=lambda c: -c["start"]):
        s, e = call["start"], call["end"]
        repl = call["replacement_tokens"]
        new_tokens[s:e] = repl
    return {"selected_call_ids": selected_ids, "tokens": new_tokens}
